answers.core:
To avoid  another minor setback of having to attach a `script` exclusively for this feature, such a simple functionality improvement might be of better usage if it was added in core.

Like previously metioned, it helps UX by not having to manually search for control nodes in the inspector tree to find who might have unwanted `mouse_filters`.
answers.workaround: It will be used often, because it increases flexibility of the control containers, allowing one to pass any `mouse_filter` wanted to it's children with a simple boolean check, however this is, rather easy to do in a few lines of tool script using a recursive `function`, however, that requires the control to attach a script, having it out of the box will improve the UX of the Godot editor.

title: Add a flag to propagate `mouse_filter` to children of Control
